title: Choose POLIS's visual world
question: I recommend Living Systems Atlas: an explorable city of AI agents where every district, flow, and macro signal opens into traceable evidence.

options.label: Living Systems Atlas
options.lineage: urban systems atlases, transit-control maps, translucent scientific overlays
options.body: A luminous 2.5D city map owns the first viewport while flows, work, housing, markets, and cognition appear as precise analytical layers. Selecting an agent opens a continuous Map → Life → Decision → Outcome trail. Risk: the city must remain a research instrument rather than drifting into game UI.

options.label: Brick Logic Manual
options.body: Every causal chain becomes an exact sequence: prior state ghosted, new evidence highlighted, and each agent decision clicked into place. Exceptionally clear for the Inspector and Causal views, but its toy lineage risks making the research instrument feel game-like.

options.label: Darkroom Evidence Bay
options.lineage: amber safelight, contact sheets, timed development stations
options.body: Runs develop from raw events into legible findings across fixed stations, with contact sheets for agents and test strips for comparison. The metaphor suits evidence and reconstruction, though extended amber use could reduce analytical clarity.
